title: Founder School Session: The Future Doesn't Have to Be Incremental
summary: Alan Kay speaks at the DEMO Founder School session on why real progress takes invention rather than incremental innovation. He argues for problem-oriented thinking and long-term research funding.
why: HN commenters treat it as a thought-provoking talk on invention versus innovation, and cite it in discussions of software complexity and startups.

quote.text: probably the most insightful and though-provoking technology talk I have ever seen
